enchantments.tooltip: Greater Boon of Undeath: Undead take solace in the hate of others. Every time a character wearing a Boon of Undeath item is struck in combat, an Inflict Moderate Wounds spell will be cast on the character.
Negative Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming negative energy healing by +53 (Profane bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Profane Spell Focus Mastery +2: +2 Profane bonus to the DC of all spells.
Profane Lifeforce +44: +44 Profane bonus to Hit Points.
Mythic Neck Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
